Ivy (release-lead): short window 03:00-03:10 UTC. pushing rti:v2.4.2 and router header tweak. call out blockers now.
Marco (runtime): ack. pin rti:v2.4.2 for window, pause scale-to-zero, disable experimental KV-evict.
Hana (router): ack. header-split linear 0->20->60->100 over 7m. hold on p95 > 450ms or router 5xx spike.
Lara (console): console will lock model switcher and show banner. adding rollback steps to runbook.
Ivy (release-lead): rollback triggers: +3% errors OR p99 > 900ms for 90s. Owen oncall?
Owen (oncall): I'm monitoring. will confirm any auto-rollback within 3m. alerts set.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: service=runtime variant=rti:v2.4.2 canary_pct=20 window=5m (ts=2855556810).
Marco (runtime): smoke: `curl -H "x-variant: rti-v2.4.2" https://api.internal/health` ; tail logs for pods.
deploy-bot: canary started at 20% (ts=2855556830).
Owen (oncall): initial metrics p50=40ms p95=205ms errors +0.08%. green.
Hana (router): ramping to 60% now.
deploy-bot: ramp complete 60% (ts=2855556875).
Marco (runtime): KV pressure normal. no GC storms.
Owen (oncall): brief p95 bump to 360ms for 45s, recovered. still below rollback thresholds.
Ivy (release-lead): proceeding to 100% in 3m if green. final check at 03:07 UTC.
deploy-bot: full rollout -> 100% (ts=2855556935).
Lara (console): keeping lock for 20m post-rollout then unlocking and posting summary.
Owen (oncall): monitoring nominal, no rollback.
Ivy (release-lead): thanks team. posting short deploy summary in 15m. will open postmortem only if >1% customer-facing errors in 24h. :tada:
